structuredContent.content:
name: PoN W1 transparent candidate observations
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/w1_hardened_verifier/**
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/w1_v2_verifier/**
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/w1_native_cost/**
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/w1_zkvm/**
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/experiments/w1_full_staged_run.py
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/experiments/w1_stage_measure.py
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/experiments/w1_local_payload.py
      - trillionnium/**
      - scripts/w1_transparent_compare.py
      - scripts/w1_profile_source_map.py
      - scripts/w1_security_budget.py
      - scripts/w1_v2_receipt_controls.py
      - scripts/ci/**
      - scripts/project-preflight.sh
      - evidence/pon-w1-complete-succinct-20261028/**
      - evidence/pon-w1-verifier-hardening-20261028/**
      - evidence/pon-w1-transparent-profile-20261104/**
      - evidence/pon-w1-statement-v2-20261105/**
      - evidence/pon-w1-qrom-budget-20261105/**
      - config/**
      - .cargo/**
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - AGENTS.md
      - PROJECT_ID
      - PROJECT_BOUNDARY.json
      - .github/workflows/pon-w1-transparent-profile.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: pon-w1-transparent-profile-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  # Preserve failed and partial observations when a newer source arrives.
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  CI: "true"
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
  RUST_TEST_THREADS: "1"
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
jobs:
  transparent-profile:
    name: W1 transparent candidate (${{ matrix.source }}, x64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        source: [head, prospective-merge]
    env:
      SOURCE_KIND: ${{ matrix.source }}
      EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      EXPECTED_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate without persistent credentials
        id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Reserve observations and verify ordered source identity
        id: source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          w1_profile_out="$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-w1-transparent-profile-$SOURCE_KIND-x64-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          mkdir "$w1_profile_out"
          mkdir "$w1_profile_out/bin"
          printf 'W1_PROFILE_OUT=%s\n' "$w1_profile_out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-w1-transparent-profile-%s-%s-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$SOURCE_KIND" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-w1-transparent-profile-%s-%s-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$SOURCE_KIND" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'Continuous candidate checks and one saved-proof observation only. No new proof, end-to-end benefit, quantum soundness, production or consensus-admission qualification is established.\n' > "$w1_profile_out/SCOPE.txt"
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$w1_profile_out/source-before.json" 2>&1 | tee "$w1_profile_out/source-before.log"
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit 2>&1 | tee "$w1_profile_out/preflight.log"
      - name: Install pinned compiler and retain tool identities
        id: toolchain
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/toolchain-install.log"
          rustc +1.95.0 -Vv > "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/rustc-version.txt"
          cargo +1.95.0 -Vv > "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/cargo-version.txt"
          python3 --version > "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/python-version.txt"
      - name: Execute source identity rejection controls
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        id: source_controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/ci/test_ci_source_integrity.py 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/source-controls.log"
      - name: Execute all 24 saved-proof observer controls
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        id: observer_tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p test_w1_transparent_compare.py -v 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/observer-tests.log"
          python3 - "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/observer-tests.log" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          text = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
          if re.findall(r'^Ran ([0-9]+) tests in ', text, re.M) != ['24'] or not re.search(r'^OK$', text, re.M):
              raise SystemExit('all 24 retained observer controls must execute without skips')
          PY
      - name: Execute all seven offline source-map controls
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        id: mapper_tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p test_w1_profile_source_map.py -v 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/mapper-tests.log"
          python3 - "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/mapper-tests.log" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          text = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
          if re.findall(r'^Ran ([0-9]+) tests in ', text, re.M) != ['7'] or not re.search(r'^OK$', text, re.M):
              raise SystemExit('all seven retained source-map controls must execute without skips')
          PY
      - name: Execute staged lifecycle and complete-observation rejection controls
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        id: staged_tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p test_w1_staged_observer.py -v 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/staged-observer-tests.log"
          python3 - "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/staged-observer-tests.log" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          text = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
          counts = re.findall(r'^Ran ([0-9]+) tests in ', text, re.M)
          if len(counts) != 1 or int(counts[0]) < 21 or not re.search(r'^OK$', text, re.M):
              raise SystemExit('all 21 retained staged-observer controls must execute without skips')
          PY
      - name: Execute exact-source component-budget rejection controls
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        id: budget_tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p test_w1_security_budget.py -v 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/security-budget-tests.log"
          python3 - "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/security-budget-tests.log" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          text = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
          counts = re.findall(r'^Ran ([0-9]+) tests in ', text, re.M)
          if len(counts) != 1 or int(counts[0]) < 21 or not re.search(r'^OK$', text, re.M):
              raise SystemExit('all 21 retained security-budget controls must execute without skips')
          PY
      - name: Verify and build the independent native crate
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success' && steps.toolchain.outcome == 'success'
        id: native
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          w1_manifest=formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/w1_native_cost/Cargo.toml
          cargo +1.95.0 metadata --locked --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" --format-version 1 > "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/native-cargo-graph.json" 2> "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/native-metadata.stderr.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 fmt --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" --all -- --check 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/native-format.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/native-tests.log"
          python3 - "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/native-tests.log" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          rows = re.findall(r'^test result: ok\. ([0-9]+) passed; 0 failed; ([0-9]+) ignored;', Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(), re.M)
          if sum(int(passed) for passed, _ in rows) < 6 or any(int(ignored) for _, ignored in rows):
              raise SystemExit('six retained native relation controls did not execute')
          PY
          cargo +1.95.0 clippy --locked --release --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/native-clippy.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 build --locked --release --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/native-build.log"
          cp "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release/w1-native-cost" "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/bin/w1-native-cost"
          sha256sum "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/bin/w1-native-cost" > "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/native-binary.sha256"
      - name: Verify and build the independent hardened verifier crate
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success' && steps.toolchain.outcome == 'success'
        id: hardened
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          w1_manifest=formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/w1_hardened_verifier/Cargo.toml
          cargo +1.95.0 metadata --locked --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" --format-version 1 > "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/hardened-cargo-graph.json" 2> "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/hardened-metadata.stderr.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 fmt --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" --all -- --check 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/hardened-format.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/hardened-tests.log"
          python3 - "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/hardened-tests.log" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          rows = re.findall(r'^test result: ok\. ([0-9]+) passed; 0 failed; ([0-9]+) ignored;', Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(), re.M)
          if sum(int(passed) for passed, _ in rows) < 15 or any(int(ignored) for _, ignored in rows):
              raise SystemExit('15 retained hardened verifier controls did not execute')
          PY
          cargo +1.95.0 clippy --locked --release --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/hardened-clippy.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 build --locked --release --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/hardened-build.log"
          cp "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release/trnm-w1-hardened-verifier" "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/bin/trnm-w1-hardened-verifier"
          sha256sum "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/bin/trnm-w1-hardened-verifier" > "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/hardened-binary.sha256"
      - name: Verify and build the independent v2 verifier without a guest build
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success' && steps.toolchain.outcome == 'success'
        id: verifier_v2
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          w1_manifest=formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/w1_v2_verifier/Cargo.toml
          cargo +1.95.0 metadata --locked --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" --format-version 1 > "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/v2-cargo-graph.json" 2> "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/v2-metadata.stderr.log"
          python3 - "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/v2-cargo-graph.json" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json, sys
          graph = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
          packages = {package['name'] for package in graph['packages']}
          if packages.intersection({'risc0-build', 'trnm-w1-zk-methods', 'trnm-w1-zk-methods-v2',
                                    'trnm-w1-full-guest', 'trnm-w1-full-guest-v2'}):
              raise SystemExit('independent v2 verifier must not acquire a guest build dependency')
          PY
          cargo +1.95.0 fmt --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" --all -- --check 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/v2-format.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/v2-tests.log"
          python3 - "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/v2-tests.log" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          rows = re.findall(r'^test result: ok\. ([0-9]+) passed; 0 failed; ([0-9]+) ignored;', Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(), re.M)
          if sum(int(passed) for passed, _ in rows) < 2 or any(int(ignored) for _, ignored in rows):
              raise SystemExit('v2 expected-artifact and historical-proof rejection controls did not execute')
          PY
          cargo +1.95.0 clippy --locked --release --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/v2-clippy.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 build --locked --release --manifest-path "$w1_manifest" 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/v2-build.log"
          cp "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release/w1-verify-v2" "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/bin/w1-verify-v2"
          sha256sum "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/bin/w1-verify-v2" > "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/v2-binary.sha256"
      - name: Reproduce the component-budget report with its unqualified boundary
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success' && steps.hardened.outcome == 'success'
        id: component_budget
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Offline reproduction of an explicit research budget. A component
          # budget failure is a valid observation, not QROM qualification.
          python3 - "$CARGO_HOME" "$W1_PROFILE_OUT" <<'PY' 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/security-budget.log"
          from pathlib import Path
          import json, subprocess, sys
          cargo, out = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
          required = ('risc0-zkp-3.0.5.crate', 'risc0-core-3.0.2.crate',
                      'risc0-circuit-recursion-4.0.5.crate', 'risc0-circuit-rv32im-4.0.5.crate')
          caches = [path for path in (cargo / 'registry/cache').glob('*')
                    if path.is_dir() and all((path / name).is_file() for name in required)]
          if len(caches) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('one complete pinned crate archive cache is required')
          report_path = out / 'security-budget.json'
          subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'scripts/w1_security_budget.py',
                          '--crate-cache', str(caches[0]), '--target-bits', '128',
                          '--output', str(report_path)], check=True)
          report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
          qualification = report['qualification']
          if (report['schema'] != 'TRNM-W1-COMPONENT-SECURITY-BUDGET1'
                  or report['research_target']['failure_probability_bits'] != 128
                  or report['research_target']['protocol_policy_adopted'] is not False
                  or qualification['quantum_security_bits'] is not None
                  or qualification['full_recursive_security_bits'] is not None
                  or any(qualification[key] is not False for key in
                         ('qrom_theorem_instantiated', 'consensus_admission',
                          'production_qualified', 'attack_on_complete_w1_established'))):
              raise SystemExit('component estimates must retain their exact unqualified scope')
          print('Component formula report reproduced; whole-proof and QROM qualification remain false.')
          PY
      - name: Reproduce the bounded source map without network access
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success' && steps.toolchain.outcome == 'success'
        id: source_map
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The mapper only reads already downloaded locked archives and sources.
          python3 scripts/w1_profile_source_map.py --cargo-home "$CARGO_HOME" --repo-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --out "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/security-map.json" 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/source-map.log"
          cmp evidence/pon-w1-transparent-profile-20261104/security-map.json "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/security-map.json" 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/source-map-comparison.log"
      - name: Observe the compiled profile and its unqualified boundary
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success' && steps.hardened.outcome == 'success'
        id: profile
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/bin/trnm-w1-hardened-verifier" profile > "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/profile.json" 2> "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/profile.stderr.log"
          python3 - "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/profile.json" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json, sys
          profile = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
          mapping = json.loads(Path('evidence/pon-w1-transparent-profile-20261104/security-map.json').read_text())
          saved, defaults = mapping['saved_full_receipt'], mapping['recursive_verifier_defaults']
          checks = [profile['schema'] == 'TRNM-W1-TRANSPARENT-PROFILE1',
              profile['profile_id'] == 'trnm-w1-risc0-3.0.6-poseidon2-join-v1',
              profile['hash_function'] == saved['hash_function'],
              profile['final_control_id'] == saved['control_id'],
              profile['verifier_parameters_digest'] == saved['verifier_parameters_digest'],
              profile['control_root'] == defaults['control_root'],
              profile['effective_inner_control_root'] == defaults['effective_inner_control_root'],
              profile['control_inclusion_depth'] == defaults['control_merkle_depth'],
              profile['quantum_security_bits'] is None,
              profile['quantum_soundness_qualified'] is False,
              profile['consensus_admission'] is False]
          if not all(checks):
              raise SystemExit('compiled profile differs from its mapped, unqualified construction')
          PY
      - name: Retain all 42 actual saved-proof acceptance and rejection controls
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success' && steps.hardened.outcome == 'success'
        id: receipt_controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          w1_proof_dir="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/evidence/pon-w1-complete-succinct-20261028/full-proof"
          "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/bin/trnm-w1-hardened-verifier" controls "$w1_proof_dir/header.bin" "$w1_proof_dir/succinct.bin" "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/controls" 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/receipt-controls.log"
          python3 - "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/controls/result.json" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json, sys
          report = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
          cases = report['cases']
          if (report['schema'] != 'TRNM-W1-HARDENED-VERIFIER-CONTROLS2'
                  or len(cases) != 42 or len({case['name'] for case in cases}) != 42
                  or report['all_passed'] is not True or report['fake_proofs_used'] is not False
                  or report['consensus_admission'] is not False
                  or any(case['passed'] is not True or case['observed']['outcome'] != case['expected']
                         or case['observed']['outcome'] not in ('ACCEPT', 'REJECT') for case in cases)):
              raise SystemExit('all 42 real controls must complete without panic or changed expectations')
          PY
      - name: Compare the saved proof under one shared 120-second deadline
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success' && steps.native.outcome == 'success' && steps.hardened.outcome == 'success'
        id: comparison
        timeout-minutes: 4
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          w1_native="$W1_PROFILE_OUT/bin/w1-native-cost"
          w1_verifier="$W1_PROFILE_OUT/bin/trnm-w1-hardened-verifier"
          w1_native_sha="$(sha256sum "$w1_native")"
          w1_native_sha="${w1_native_sha%% *}"
          w1_verifier_sha="$(sha256sum "$w1_verifier")"
          w1_verifier_sha="${w1_verifier_sha%% *}"
          python3 scripts/w1_transparent_compare.py \
            --proof-dir "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/evidence/pon-w1-complete-succinct-20261028/full-proof" \
            --native "$w1_native" --verifier "$w1_verifier" \
            --native-sha256 "$w1_native_sha" --verifier-sha256 "$w1_verifier_sha" \
            --native-source-commit "$EXPECTED_SOURCE" --verifier-source-commit "$EXPECTED_SOURCE" \
            --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --out "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/comparison" \
            --total-wall-seconds 120 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/comparison.log"
          python3 - "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/comparison/result.json" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json, sys
          report = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
          if (report['outcome'] != 'SAVED_PROOF_COMPARISON_COMPLETE' or report['qualification'] != 'HOLD'
                  or report['new_proofs_generated'] != 0 or report['logical_work_items'] != 1
                  or any(report[key] is not False for key in ('end_to_end_benefit_established',
                      'quantum_soundness_qualified', 'consensus_admission',
                      'production_tail_established', 'source_equivalence_established'))):
              raise SystemExit('saved-proof observation must retain its unqualified scope')
          PY
      - name: Verify measured source after execution
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        id: source_after
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/source-after.json" 2>&1 | tee "$W1_PROFILE_OUT/source-after.log"
      - name: Record completed, failed and skipped observations
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          W1_PROFILE_STEP_RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(steps) }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          w1_profile_out="$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-w1-transparent-profile-$SOURCE_KIND-x64-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          mkdir -p "$w1_profile_out"
          python3 - "$w1_profile_out/ci-status.json" <<'PY'
          import json, os, sys
          report = {'schema': 'TRNM-W1-TRANSPARENT-CI-OBSERVATION1',
              'source_kind': os.environ['SOURCE_KIND'], 'expected_source': os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE'],
              'steps': json.loads(os.environ['W1_PROFILE_STEP_RESULTS']),
              'scope': 'Continuous candidate checks; failed and partial observations are retained.',
              'end_to_end_benefit_established': False, 'quantum_soundness_qualified': False,
              'production_qualified': False, 'consensus_admission': False}
          with open(sys.argv[1], 'x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
              json.dump(report, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
              stream.write('\n')
          PY
      - name: Retain source identities, binaries, logs and all failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: w1-transparent-profile-${{ matrix.source }}-x64-${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pon-w1-transparent-profile-${{ matrix.source }}-x64-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
